listings.title: Welder Helper
listings.source: Job Bank (cross-posted on SimplyHired and Indeed; apply link goes to Indeed)
listings.whyT176: Assist welders with cutting, grinding and cleaning metal, component assembly, plasma cutting under supervision, crane/forklift material handling, blueprint familiarity - direct Semester-1 welding reinforcement in a structural steel shop.
listings.mainGate: 'Welding: 2 years' is listed as preferred (asset, not a hard gate); full-time hours must be squared with the class timetable.
listings.applicationAngle: Lead with T176 welding coursework and shop-tool competence; emphasize willingness to do prep/grind work and flexible availability. Posted Aug 17 - apply fast.

listings.title: Welder Apprentice (Union)
listings.source: Glassdoor/ZipRecruiter/Workopolis mirrors; employer ATS is trench.csod.com (portal live, but this run could not re-verify the posting inside it - mirrors returned 403)
listings.whyT176: Union welder apprenticeship at a high-voltage transformer manufacturer - manual and robotic welding machines, formal apprenticeship pathway, recognized union training. Highest career-capital role found.
listings.mainGate: Board mirrors label it 'Mid-Level (3+ years)' and it was posted ~Jul 24, so it may prefer experienced apprentices or already be filled; posting could not be re-verified live this run.
listings.applicationAngle: STRETCH rationale: 'Apprentice' title plus union pathway, and no verified mandatory licence/years gate - worth applying despite the experience label. Apply through the Trench careers portal (trench.csod.com) and name T176 enrollment as apprenticeship readiness.

listings.title: Apprentice Welder/Helper
listings.source: Glassdoor (Easy Apply); employer site jkqualitywelding.com has no careers page
listings.whyT176: True entry apprentice-helper: basic MIG/TIG, blueprint reading, calipers/dimensional inspection - at a cryogenic piping and welding shop, so it touches BOTH Semester-1 trades (welding + piping).
listings.mainGate: Commute: Newmarket from Dovercourt/Bloor is roughly 1.5-2h each way by transit (GO/Viva) - a substantial daily burden.
listings.applicationAngle: Easy Apply on Glassdoor; pitch the welding+piping double fit and genuine entry-level expectations ($18-19.50 signals a training wage, not an experience gate).

listings.title: Spot Welder Apprentice
listings.pay: CAD $30.24/hour + extended health benefits and life insurance
listings.source: talent.com (Atkore careers page not re-verified this run); posting 30+ days old - repost risk
listings.whyT176: Supervised operation of spot-welding and similar plant machinery with explicit train-up intent ('able to be taught'), LOTO/machine-guarding safety exposure, Lean manufacturing environment.
listings.mainGate: Fixed Mon-Fri 7:30-16:00 hours conflict with full-time daytime study; 1-2 years manufacturing/fabrication experience is preferred; spot welding is narrower than fabrication welding.
listings.applicationAngle: Only pursue if the timetable can absorb weekday day shifts (e.g. evening-weighted semester); emphasize manufacturing safety mindset and trainability.

listings.title: Plumber Helper
listings.source: Job Bank (direct apply via Job Bank account)
listings.whyT176: The only accessible GTA plumbing-helper entry point this run: plumbing contractor environment, 1-7 months experience accepted, shift options that can fit a class timetable.
listings.mainGate: Posted duties read as general construction labour (concrete forms, asphalt, traffic direction) rather than piping - actual plumbing exposure is uncertain. Expires Sep 4.
listings.applicationAngle: Apply via Job Bank before Sep 4; in the application, ask what share of the work is hands-on plumbing/piping and state evening/weekend availability.
